statement: file_id=SRC-05;file_class=SOURCE;authority_level=2;governed_by=GOV-00;status=ACTIVE
violation: SRC-05 lacks the canonical FILE-META record or uses a non-ACTIVE status without higher-authority direction.
verification: Verify the first SRC-05 metadata record exactly matches the canonical metadata statement.

statement: SRC-05 owns LedgerEntry semantics, journal ordering semantics, temporal anchoring semantics, commit atomicity semantics, commit plan semantics, and system invariant statements.
violation: A generated source record routes SRC-05-owned ledger, journal, temporal anchoring, commit atomicity, commit plan, or invariant semantics to a file other than SRC-05.
verification: Check SRC-05-owned records against SRC-INDEX responsibility routing.

statement: SRC-05 owns LEDGER-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines LEDGER-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate LEDGER-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 is a SOURCE class governed file.
violation: SRC-05 is generated with any class other than SOURCE.
verification: Validate the class field of every SRC-05 record equals SOURCE.

statement: SRC-05 has authority_level 2.
violation: SRC-05 is generated with any authority_level other than 2.
verification: Validate the authority_level field of every SRC-05 record equals 2.

statement: SRC-05 owns JOURNAL-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines JOURNAL-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate JOURNAL-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 owns TIME-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines TIME-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate TIME-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 owns ATOMIC-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines ATOMIC-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate ATOMIC-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 owns COMMIT-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines COMMIT-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate COMMIT-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 owns INV-* record ids.
violation: A generated source record defines INV-* semantics outside SRC-05.
verification: Validate INV-* record ownership against SRC-INDEX namespace routing.

statement: SRC-05 must not define source truth owned by SRC-00, SRC-01, SRC-02, SRC-03, SRC-04, or SRC-06 through SRC-10.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines source truth routed to another SRC file by SRC-INDEX.
verification: Compare each SRC-05 statement against SRC-INDEX responsibility and namespace maps.

statement: LedgerEntry is the authoritative journal record for balance-affecting proof.
violation: A record other than LedgerEntry is treated as authoritative journal proof for balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review journal proof records for LedgerEntry authority.

statement: LedgerEntry has entryId.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks entryId.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for entryId.

statement: LedgerEntry has operationId.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks operationId.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for operationId.

statement: LedgerEntry has accountId.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks accountId.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for accountId.

statement: LedgerEntry has assetId.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks assetId.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for assetId.

statement: LedgerEntry has direction.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks direction.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for direction.

statement: LedgerEntry has amount.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks amount.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for amount.

statement: LedgerEntry has createdAt.
violation: LedgerEntry lacks createdAt.
verification: Review LedgerEntry field registry for createdAt.

statement: LedgerEntry.direction domain is exactly DEBIT or CREDIT.
violation: LedgerEntry.direction accepts a value outside DEBIT or CREDIT or omits one of those values.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.direction domain for exactly DEBIT and CREDIT.

statement: LedgerEntry.entryId must be globally unique within Ledger Core.
violation: Two LedgerEntry records in Ledger Core share the same entryId.
verification: Scan LedgerEntry records for globally unique entryId values within Ledger Core.

statement: LedgerEntry must reference a valid Operation, while Operation record semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: A LedgerEntry references a missing or invalid Operation, or SRC-05 redefines Operation record semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.operationId references against authoritative Operation records with Operation semantics routed to SRC-02.

statement: LedgerEntry must reference a valid Account, while Account semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: A LedgerEntry references a missing or invalid Account, or SRC-05 redefines Account semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.accountId references against authoritative Account records with Account semantics routed to SRC-02.

statement: LedgerEntry must reference a valid Asset, while Asset semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: A LedgerEntry references a missing or invalid Asset, or SRC-05 redefines Asset semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.assetId references against authoritative Asset records with Asset semantics routed to SRC-02.

statement: LedgerEntry must not exist without a parent Operation.
violation: A LedgerEntry exists without a parent Operation.
verification: Scan LedgerEntry records for missing parent Operation references.

statement: LedgerEntry amount must use the authoritative amount representation owned by SRC-02.
violation: LedgerEntry.amount uses a representation not defined by SRC-02 AMOUNT-* records, or SRC-05 redefines amount semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.amount representation for dependency on AMOUNT-* authoritative representation.

statement: LedgerEntry.createdAt must use the canonical timestamp semantics owned by TIME-* records in SRC-05.
violation: LedgerEntry.createdAt uses a timestamp not governed by TIME-* canonical timestamp semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.createdAt for canonical timestamp dependency.

statement: LedgerEntry records are append-only.
violation: LedgerEntry records are treated as mutable after commit.
verification: Review ledger-entry semantics for append-only status.

statement: LedgerEntry records must not be deleted.
violation: A committed LedgerEntry record is deleted.
verification: Scan ledger history for deleted committed LedgerEntry records.

statement: LedgerEntry records must not be rewritten.
violation: A committed LedgerEntry record is rewritten.
verification: Scan ledger history for rewritten committed LedgerEntry records.

statement: LedgerEntry records must not be reordered after commit.
violation: Committed LedgerEntry ordering changes after commit.
verification: Review journal ordering snapshots for post-commit reorder.

statement: Committed LedgerEntry records must remain durable source truth.
violation: Committed LedgerEntry records are treated as disposable, derived, or non-authoritative.
verification: Review committed LedgerEntry durability and authority claims.

statement: Journal history is more authoritative than derived Read Model projections.
violation: A derived Read Model projection is treated as more authoritative than journal history.
verification: Review read-derived claims for journal history priority over projections.

statement: Any balance-affecting operation must create one or more LedgerEntry records.
violation: A balance-affecting operation commits without creating any LedgerEntry records.
verification: Review committed balance-affecting operations for at least one LedgerEntry.

statement: Any committed Transfer must create exactly two LedgerEntry records, while Transfer-specific operation semantics remain owned by SRC-03.
violation: A committed Transfer creates fewer or more than two LedgerEntry records, or SRC-05 redefines Transfer validation semantics.
verification: Review committed Transfer journal proof for exactly two LedgerEntry records with Transfer semantics routed to SRC-03.

statement: A committed Transfer must create one DEBIT LedgerEntry for the source account.
violation: A committed Transfer lacks exactly one source-account DEBIT LedgerEntry.
verification: Review committed Transfer journal proof for one source-account DEBIT LedgerEntry.

statement: A committed Transfer must create one CREDIT LedgerEntry for the destination account.
violation: A committed Transfer lacks exactly one destination-account CREDIT LedgerEntry.
verification: Review committed Transfer journal proof for one destination-account CREDIT LedgerEntry.

statement: Balance mutation without required LedgerEntry proof is invalid.
violation: A balance mutation commits without required LedgerEntry proof.
verification: Review committed balance mutations for corresponding required LedgerEntry proof.

statement: Orphan LedgerEntry records are invalid.
violation: A LedgerEntry has no parent Operation.
verification: Scan ledger entries for missing parent Operation references.

statement: Journal history is the ordered collection of authoritative LedgerEntry records.
violation: Journal history is defined without authoritative LedgerEntry ordering.
verification: Review journal history definition for ordered authoritative LedgerEntry records.

statement: LedgerEntry records must have deterministic ordering.
violation: LedgerEntry ordering is nondeterministic.
verification: Review LedgerEntry ordering rules for deterministic ordering.

statement: For Transfer, the DEBIT LedgerEntry should be ordered before the CREDIT LedgerEntry unless later active source authority changes this.
violation: A Transfer CREDIT LedgerEntry is ordered before the DEBIT LedgerEntry without explicit active source authority.
verification: Review Transfer LedgerEntry ordering for DEBIT before CREDIT or later active source override.

statement: LedgerEntry ordering must be preserved across upgrade, while upgrade mechanics remain owned by SRC-08.
violation: LedgerEntry ordering changes across upgrade or SRC-05 defines upgrade mechanics.
verification: Review pre-upgrade and post-upgrade LedgerEntry ordering with upgrade mechanics routed to SRC-08.

statement: A committed Operation must be queryable by operationId, while API semantics remain owned by SRC-09.
violation: A committed Operation is not queryable by operationId, or SRC-05 defines API semantics.
verification: Review committed Operation lookup capability by operationId with API semantics routed to SRC-09.

statement: LedgerEntries must be queryable by operationId, while API semantics remain owned by SRC-09.
violation: LedgerEntries are not queryable by operationId, or SRC-05 defines API semantics.
verification: Review LedgerEntry lookup capability by operationId with API semantics routed to SRC-09.

statement: Journal cursor progression must be monotonic.
violation: A journal cursor regresses or advances non-monotonically.
verification: Review journal cursor progression for monotonicity.

statement: Journal checkpoints must expose enough cursor information for Read Model sync, while Read Model sync semantics remain owned by SRC-07.
violation: Journal checkpoints lack enough cursor information for Read Model sync or SRC-05 defines Read Model sync semantics.
verification: Review journal checkpoint cursor contents for sufficient sync input with Read Model sync semantics routed to SRC-07.

statement: Read Model sync must not skip committed LedgerEntry records, while Read Model sync semantics remain owned by SRC-07.
violation: Read Model sync skips committed LedgerEntry records or SRC-05 defines detailed sync mechanics.
verification: Review journal-to-Read Model sync claims for no skipped committed LedgerEntry records.

statement: Journal append behavior must be testable, while test-proof records remain owned by SRC-10.
violation: Journal append behavior cannot be observed or tested, or SRC-05 defines test-proof semantics.
verification: Review journal append behavior for observable testability with test-proof semantics routed to SRC-10.

statement: Ledger Core must capture one canonical timestamp per operation commit.
violation: A committed operation uses zero or multiple canonical commit timestamps.
verification: Review committed operation records for exactly one canonical timestamp anchor.

statement: Timestamp creation must occur inside Ledger Core.
violation: Canonical operation timestamp is created outside Ledger Core.
verification: Review timestamp source for creation inside Ledger Core.

statement: Timestamp creation must not occur in Gateway.
violation: Gateway creates the authoritative canonical operation timestamp.
verification: Review timestamp source for absence of Gateway-created authoritative timestamp.

statement: The same canonical timestamp should be used for Operation.createdAt.
violation: Operation.createdAt uses a different timestamp from the canonical operation timestamp without explicit source authority.
verification: Review Operation.createdAt for reuse of the canonical operation timestamp.

statement: The same canonical timestamp should be used for Operation.completedAt.
violation: Operation.completedAt uses a different timestamp from the canonical operation timestamp without explicit source authority.
verification: Review Operation.completedAt for reuse of the canonical operation timestamp.

statement: The same canonical timestamp should be used for LedgerEntry.createdAt.
violation: LedgerEntry.createdAt uses a different timestamp from the canonical operation timestamp without explicit source authority.
verification: Review LedgerEntry.createdAt for reuse of the canonical operation timestamp.

statement: The same canonical timestamp should be used for Balance.updatedAt.
violation: Balance.updatedAt uses a different timestamp from the canonical operation timestamp without explicit source authority.
verification: Review Balance.updatedAt for reuse of the canonical operation timestamp.

statement: The same canonical timestamp should be used for IdempotencyRecord.completedAt.
violation: IdempotencyRecord.completedAt uses a different timestamp from the canonical operation timestamp without explicit source authority.
verification: Review IdempotencyRecord.completedAt for reuse of the canonical operation timestamp.

statement: Duplicate replay must return the original canonical timestamp, while replay semantics remain owned by SRC-04.
violation: Duplicate replay returns a replay-time timestamp or SRC-05 defines replay semantics.
verification: Review duplicate replay timestamp output for original canonical timestamp preservation with replay semantics routed to SRC-04.

statement: Read Model sync timestamp must not replace authoritative commit timestamp.
violation: Read Model sync timestamp replaces the authoritative commit timestamp.
verification: Review Read Model sync timestamp use for non-replacement of authoritative commit timestamp.

statement: Replay-time timestamp must not overwrite the original committed timestamp.
violation: Replay-time timestamp overwrites the original committed timestamp.
verification: Review replay behavior for preservation of original committed timestamp.

statement: Temporal anchoring must be observable across all records created in one committed operation.
violation: Records created in one committed operation cannot be checked for canonical timestamp consistency.
verification: Review committed Operation, LedgerEntry, Balance, and IdempotencyRecord timestamps for observable temporal anchoring.

statement: Ledger correctness is atomic only inside the Ledger Core Canister authoritative state transition.
violation: Ledger correctness is treated as atomic outside the Ledger Core Canister authoritative state transition.
verification: Review atomicity claims for Ledger Core local authoritative state transition boundary.

statement: Cross-canister calls must be treated as asynchronous.
violation: A cross-canister call is treated as not asynchronous.
verification: Review cross-canister call semantics for treatment as asynchronous.

statement: Cross-canister calls must be treated as fallible.
violation: A cross-canister call is treated as not fallible.
verification: Review cross-canister call semantics for treatment as fallible.

statement: Cross-canister calls must be treated as non-transactional.
violation: A cross-canister call is treated as not non-transactional.
verification: Review cross-canister call semantics for treatment as non-transactional.

statement: No cross-canister call may be required to complete the authoritative balance and journal commit in MVP.
violation: An MVP authoritative balance and journal commit requires a cross-canister call.
verification: Review authoritative commit sequence for absence of required cross-canister calls.

statement: Read Model update failure must not roll back Ledger Core commit, while Read Model semantics remain owned by SRC-07.
violation: A Read Model update failure rolls back Ledger Core commit or SRC-05 defines Read Model semantics.
verification: Review commit behavior for Ledger Core commit independence from Read Model update failure.

statement: Journal creation failure must invalidate balance mutation because authoritative journal lives inside Ledger Core.
violation: Balance mutation commits when required journal creation fails.
verification: Review commit behavior for balance mutation abort on required journal creation failure.

statement: Failed commit must not expose partial state as committed.
violation: A failed commit exposes partial state as committed.
verification: Review failed commit behavior for absence of partial committed state visibility.

statement: Ledger Core must not await any inter-canister call after beginning authoritative state mutation and before commit completion.
violation: Ledger Core awaits an inter-canister call after authoritative state mutation begins and before commit completion.
verification: Review authoritative commit sequence for no inter-canister await during mutation.

statement: Authoritative commit must be performed as one local Ledger Core state transition.
violation: Authoritative commit is split across multiple local or cross-canister state transitions.
verification: Review authoritative commit boundary for one local Ledger Core state transition.

statement: Read Model sync must occur only after Ledger Core commit.
violation: Read Model sync occurs before or during Ledger Core commit.
verification: Review Read Model sync ordering for after Ledger Core commit only.

statement: Read Model sync must not be required for commit success.
violation: Commit success depends on Read Model sync completion.
verification: Review commit success criteria for exclusion of Read Model sync completion.

statement: Gateway-to-Ledger-Core execution may cross canister boundaries before commit begins, while Gateway authority remains owned by SRC-01.
violation: Pre-commit Gateway-to-Ledger-Core boundary crossing is rejected without active source authority or SRC-05 redefines Gateway authority.
verification: Review write path for Gateway-to-Ledger-Core boundary before authoritative commit begins.

statement: No cross-canister call may be inside the authoritative commit mutation sequence.
violation: An authoritative commit mutation sequence includes a cross-canister call.
verification: Review authoritative commit mutation sequence for absence of cross-canister calls.

statement: Any design requiring a separate Journal Canister for MVP authoritative commit violates atomicity and the ADR owned by SRC-00.
violation: MVP authoritative commit requires a separate Journal Canister.
verification: Review MVP architecture for absence of separate Journal Canister requirement in authoritative commit.

statement: Ledger Core should build a complete commit plan before mutation.
violation: Ledger Core mutates authoritative state before building a complete commit plan without explicit source authority.
verification: Review commit sequence for complete commit plan before authoritative mutation.

statement: CommitPlan must be constructed before authoritative mutation.
violation: Authoritative mutation occurs before CommitPlan construction.
verification: Review commit sequence for CommitPlan construction before mutation.

statement: CommitPlan must include Operation.
violation: CommitPlan lacks Operation.
verification: Review CommitPlan completeness for Operation.

statement: CommitPlan must include LedgerEntries.
violation: CommitPlan lacks LedgerEntries.
verification: Review CommitPlan completeness for LedgerEntries.

statement: CommitPlan must include BalanceMutations.
violation: CommitPlan lacks BalanceMutations.
verification: Review CommitPlan completeness for BalanceMutations.

statement: CommitPlan must include Idempotency outcome.
violation: CommitPlan lacks Idempotency outcome.
verification: Review CommitPlan completeness for Idempotency outcome.

statement: CommitPlan must include canonical timestamp.
violation: CommitPlan lacks canonical timestamp.
verification: Review CommitPlan completeness for canonical timestamp.

statement: CommitPlan must pass invariant validation before mutation.
violation: CommitPlan is applied before invariant validation passes.
verification: Review commit sequence for invariant validation before mutation.

statement: Commit application must be performed only by Ledger Core, while Ledger Core authority remains owned by SRC-01.
violation: A component other than Ledger Core applies CommitPlan or SRC-05 redefines Ledger Core authority.
verification: Review CommitPlan application authority for Ledger Core-only application.

statement: Operation modules must return intent or BalanceChangePlan only.
violation: An operation module returns authoritative committed state instead of intent or BalanceChangePlan.
verification: Review operation module boundary for intent or BalanceChangePlan output only.

statement: Operation modules must not apply CommitPlan directly.
violation: An operation module applies CommitPlan directly.
verification: Review operation module boundary for absence of direct CommitPlan application.

statement: CommitPlan construction and invariant validation must complete before any authoritative mutation is applied.
violation: An authoritative mutation is applied before CommitPlan construction and invariant validation complete.
verification: Review commit sequence for completed CommitPlan construction and invariant validation before mutation.

statement: Commit application must not expose partial committed state.
violation: Commit application exposes partial state as committed.
verification: Review commit application behavior for no partial committed state exposure.

statement: Commit application must not bypass ledger proof requirements.
violation: Commit application commits a balance-affecting operation without required ledger proof.
verification: Review CommitPlan and commit application for required LedgerEntry proof.

statement: Commit application must not bypass idempotency outcome requirements owned by SRC-04.
violation: Commit application bypasses idempotency outcome requirements or SRC-05 redefines idempotency semantics.
verification: Review CommitPlan and commit application for idempotency outcome dependency routed to SRC-04.

statement: Every balance change must have one or more LedgerEntry records.
violation: A balance change has no LedgerEntry record.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: LedgerEntry records must be append-only.
violation: A LedgerEntry record is mutated after append.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Duplicate requests must not create duplicate effects, while duplicate behavior is owned by SRC-04.
violation: A duplicate request creates duplicate balance or journal effects, or SRC-05 redefines duplicate behavior.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Operation fully commits or does not commit.
violation: An operation partially commits.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Balance must not become negative, while Balance amount semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: A Balance becomes negative or SRC-05 redefines Balance amount semantics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Asset IDs must match across all entries in one operation, while Asset and Transfer validation semantics remain owned by SRC-02 and SRC-03.
violation: Asset IDs mismatch across entries in one operation, or SRC-05 redefines Asset or Transfer validation semantics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Gateway must not authorize balance changes, while Gateway authority semantics remain owned by SRC-01.
violation: Gateway authorizes balance changes or SRC-05 redefines Gateway authority.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Read Model must not mutate authoritative state, while Read Model semantics remain owned by SRC-07.
violation: Read Model mutates authoritative state or SRC-05 defines Read Model semantics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Operation modules must not write state directly.
violation: An operation module writes authoritative state directly.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Ledger Core is the only balance-affecting authority, while Ledger Core authority semantics remain owned by SRC-01.
violation: A component other than Ledger Core acts as balance-affecting authority or SRC-05 redefines Ledger Core authority.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Committed operations must have authoritative journal entries.
violation: A committed operation lacks authoritative journal entries.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Failed Read Model update must not invalidate Ledger Core commit.
violation: A failed Read Model update invalidates Ledger Core commit.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Canister upgrade must not rewrite journal history, while upgrade mechanics remain owned by SRC-08.
violation: Canister upgrade rewrites journal history or SRC-05 defines upgrade mechanics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Caller must be authorized to debit source account, while caller authorization semantics remain owned by SRC-01 and SRC-03.
violation: A source account debit occurs without authorized caller, or SRC-05 redefines caller authorization semantics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: One canonical timestamp should anchor all records in one commit.
violation: Records in one commit use inconsistent canonical timestamps without active source authority.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Authoritative amounts must use exact integer minor units, while amount representation remains owned by SRC-02.
violation: An authoritative amount uses a non-integer-minor-unit representation or SRC-05 redefines amount representation.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Bootstrap authority must not create runtime mutation bypasses, while bootstrap authority remains owned by SRC-01.
violation: Bootstrap authority creates a runtime mutation bypass or SRC-05 redefines bootstrap authority.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: Stable state must preserve committed operations and idempotency outcomes, while stable-state mechanics remain owned by SRC-08.
violation: Stable state fails to preserve committed operations or idempotency outcomes, or SRC-05 defines stable-state mechanics.
verification: Review invariant scan and source-mapped verification for this invariant.

statement: SRC-05 owns system invariant statements.
violation: System invariant statements are defined by a file other than SRC-05.
verification: Review invariant records for SRC-05 ownership.

statement: Invariant claims must not be inferred from passing tests.
violation: An invariant claim is justified only by passing tests.
verification: Review invariant claims for governed source trace instead of test-output inference.

statement: Invariant claims must not be inferred from runtime behavior.
violation: An invariant claim is justified only by runtime behavior.
verification: Review invariant claims for governed source trace instead of runtime inference.

statement: Invariant claims must not be inferred from code structure alone.
violation: An invariant claim is justified only by code structure.
verification: Review invariant claims for governed source trace instead of code-structure inference.

statement: Invariant validation must be observable.
violation: Invariant validation cannot be observed.
verification: Review invariant validation for observable checks.

statement: Invariant validation must include valid-path coverage where applicable.
violation: Applicable valid-path behavior lacks invariant validation coverage.
verification: Review invariant validation mapping for valid-path coverage where applicable.

statement: Invariant validation must include invalid-path coverage where applicable.
violation: Applicable invalid-path behavior lacks invariant validation coverage.
verification: Review invariant validation mapping for invalid-path coverage where applicable.

statement: Invariant validation must include explicit falsifier coverage where applicable.
violation: Applicable invariant behavior lacks explicit falsifier coverage.
verification: Review invariant validation mapping for explicit falsifier coverage where applicable.

statement: Tests are verification evidence only when source-mapped to invariant records, while test-proof semantics remain owned by SRC-10.
violation: Tests are treated as correctness authority or SRC-05 defines test-proof semantics.
verification: Review tests as evidence only when mapped to invariant records and route test-proof semantics to SRC-10.

statement: Any untraceable invariant claim is invalid.
violation: An invariant claim lacks trace to governed source authority.
verification: Resolve trace arrays for invariant claims against governed source authority.

statement: Balance mutation requires corresponding journal proof.
violation: A balance mutation lacks corresponding journal proof.
verification: Review balance mutations for corresponding LedgerEntry proof.

statement: Journal proof must be created inside the same authoritative commit boundary as the balance mutation.
violation: Journal proof is created outside the authoritative commit boundary of the balance mutation.
verification: Review commit boundary for journal proof creation in the same authoritative commit as balance mutation.

statement: Balance mutation must not commit if required journal proof cannot be constructed.
violation: Balance mutation commits when required journal proof cannot be constructed.
verification: Review commit plan construction for required journal proof before balance mutation commit.

statement: Balance mutation must not commit if required journal proof cannot be validated.
violation: Balance mutation commits when required journal proof cannot be validated.
verification: Review invariant validation for required journal proof before balance mutation commit.

statement: Balance mutation must not commit if required journal proof cannot be appended.
violation: Balance mutation commits when required journal proof cannot be appended.
verification: Review commit application for required journal proof append before balance mutation commit.

statement: Authoritative balance state must remain explainable from bootstrap state plus journal history, while Balance entity semantics remain owned by SRC-02.
violation: Authoritative balance state cannot be explained from bootstrap state plus journal history or SRC-05 redefines Balance entity semantics.
verification: Review balance explainability against bootstrap state plus journal history with Balance semantics routed to SRC-02.

statement: Journal history must be sufficient to prove committed balance-affecting operations.
violation: Journal history is insufficient to prove committed balance-affecting operations.
verification: Review journal history for proof sufficiency over committed balance-affecting operations.

statement: Derived Read Model projection must not replace authoritative journal proof.
violation: A derived Read Model projection replaces authoritative journal proof.
verification: Review proof path for authoritative journal proof instead of derived projection.

statement: SRC-05 must not define project identity semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines project identity semantics instead of referencing SRC-00.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define canister authority or caller identity semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines canister authority or caller identity semantics instead of referencing SRC-01.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define Account, Asset, Balance, Amount, or Operation record entity semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines Account, Asset, Balance, Amount, or Operation record entity semantics instead of referencing SRC-02.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define Transfer validation, lifecycle transition, or result contract semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines Transfer validation, lifecycle transition, or result contract semantics instead of referencing SRC-03.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define idempotency key derivation, duplicate behavior, replay storage, or IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines idempotency key derivation, duplicate behavior, replay storage, or IN_PROGRESS recovery semantics instead of referencing SRC-04.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define failure-class semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines failure-class semantics instead of referencing SRC-06.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define detailed Read Model derivation semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines Read Model derivation, sync, freshness, or rebuild semantics instead of referencing SRC-07.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define upgrade or stable-state mechanics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines upgrade or stable-state mechanics instead of referencing SRC-08.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define API or forbidden behavior records.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines API or forbidden behavior records instead of referencing SRC-09.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not define test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics.
violation: A SRC-05 record defines test-proof, DONE, risk, or falsifier semantics instead of referencing SRC-10.
verification: Review SRC-05 records for non-owned semantic definitions.

statement: SRC-05 must not include implementation guidance.
violation: A SRC-05 record includes implementation guidance, build procedure, codegen procedure, framework workflow, or target-file instructions.
verification: Search SRC-05 statements for implementation guidance or build workflow terms.

statement: Ledger and journal claims must not be inferred from code.
violation: A ledger or journal claim is justified by code behavior instead of governed source authority.
verification: Review trace arrays and reports for code-derived ledger or journal claims.

statement: Ledger and journal claims must not be inferred from tests.
violation: A ledger or journal claim is justified by test output instead of governed source authority.
